location.ref: Bāṇī of Garībdās, on Kabīr as the supreme

paraphrase: Kabīr is the supreme Lord who came from Satlok; he met Garībdās in the fields and showed him the true world; the gods of the three worlds are below him.
speaker: Garībdās
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Thematic summary.
